intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Multiply same base → ADD powers: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ
2  Divide same base → SUBTRACT powers: aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ
3  Power of a power → MULTIPLY: (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ
commonMistakes: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ — ADD, not multiply.
intro.visualAid: Summary table: Operation → Rule → Example. Multiply → add powers → x² × x³ = x⁵. Divide → subtract powers → x⁵ ÷ x² = x³. Power of power → multiply → (x²)³ = x⁶. Zero → equals 1 → x⁰ = 1.
